scope: Image mockups only. No app code, user trip data or deployment changes.

assets.prompt:
Create a TripLOG travel-tools redesign mockup showing a 1280 CSS px desktop view and a 390 CSS px mobile view side by side. Follow the existing TripLOG shared components: white surfaces, dark navy #0b1020 text and 1.5px outlines, 9–14px corners, short navy offset shadows, yellow #fff05a primary actions and selected tabs, pale-blue #bce6fb secondary buttons, restrained pink accents, small reusable colored icons. Use compact Korean typography: 20px/600 page titles, 15px/600 section headings, 13–14px body, 12px metadata, and 16px input text. Icons sit naturally with their background without extra outlined icon boxes.

Keep the TripLOG wordmark with LOG on a pink highlight, page title “여행”, the compact shared trip context “가을 도쿄 여행 / 2026.10.20 화 – 10.24 토 / 4박 5일”, and equal tabs “오늘의 여행 / 예약 지갑 / 여행 도구”, with “여행 도구” selected in yellow. Preserve the five equal bottom-navigation items “개요 / 일정 / 여행 / 지출 / 리포트”, with 여행 active.

Prioritize a useful “준비물” section using the existing compact checkbox-list component. Show 3/7 progress, a thin blue progress bar, “전체 / 미완료 / 완료” filters, a small blue plus action, and unchecked rows “보조배터리”, “상비약”, “접이식 우산”, with discreet pencils. A small “전체 보기” action opens management.

Below, show two compact practical tools: “환율 계산”, displaying the configured rate “100엔 = 950원” and a blue “계산하기” button; and “현지 시간”, showing 한국 14:30 and 도쿄 14:30 with “시차 0시간” and the existing timezone-selection control. These use small calculator and clock icons and the same standard button/dropdown styles.

Add a “빠른 메모” section using the existing text-input and simple editable-row styles. Show “짐 보관함 A-126”, “eSIM 설치 링크”, a small copy/pencil action, and a single-line “새 메모” input with a blue plus button.

Add “여행 자료” as three clean shared settings-list rows: “포켓노트 · HTML”, “캘린더 · ICS”, and “일정표 · PDF”, each with a small icon and right chevron. No file uploads.

On desktop, place preparation and notes in the left column and the paired tools and export rows in the right column. On mobile, use the same sections vertically, with the two small tools in two columns. Keep the main content practical and compact, without repeated explanatory sentences, a large hero illustration, destination photos, weather, nearby search, or duplicated reservation/expense dashboards. Show app content without device hardware.

Create three connected TripLOG mobile detail mockups, each 390 CSS px wide, side by side: “준비물 관리”, “환율 계산”, and “포켓노트 저장”. Reuse the same existing shared dialog shell, TripLOG pink-highlight wordmark, top-right X, compact trip context, white surface, thin navy outlines, 9–14px corners, short offset shadows, yellow primary buttons, pale-blue secondary controls, and compact typography. Body text is 13–14px, headings 20px/600, input text 16px/500. Show only reusable small icons and no device hardware.

Preparation management: show 3/7 and a thin blue progress bar, shared filter tabs “전체 7 / 미완료 4 / 완료 3”, and seven compact checkbox rows. “여권”, “eSIM”, and “충전기” are checked; “보조배터리”, “상비약”, “접이식 우산”, and “엔화 현금” are unchecked. Include small row pencil/menu actions, a single-line “새 준비물” input with a blue plus button, and the standard yellow “완료” footer. Checks are immediate; no per-item save buttons.

Currency calculator: use the expense editor’s existing currency selector, amount input, rate row, and conversion-summary styles. Show JPY input “3,000” 엔, quick amount chips “1,000 / 3,000 / 5,000” with 3,000 selected, and a clearly aligned result “≈ 28,500원” with a small copy icon. Label the basis “여행 설정 환율”. Show “100엔 = 950원” and a small “환율 수정” control with its inline rate input expanded, following the existing expense rate-panel design. End with the existing yellow action style “지출로 기록”; this is a handoff to a prefilled expense form, not an immediate saved expense. Do not label the illustrative rate as live or current-market data.

Pocket-note export: show the shared checkbox-selection rows “여행 일정” with “24개”, “예약정보·번호” with “4건”, and “기록된 경비” with “18건”. Select the first two and leave recorded expenses unchecked. A compact pale-blue preview shows an HTML file icon, “가을 도쿄 여행_포켓노트.html”, and “일정·주소 / 예약정보·번호”. A short note reads “저장 시점의 정보 · 지도와 외부 링크는 인터넷 필요”. End with the standard yellow “파일 저장” action. Do not invent file sizes, cloud backup, automatic calendar sync, or attachment uploads.
